name: stdlib-http-client
summary: One urllib HTTP client for every upstream: timeouts, bounded retries with backoff, a size ceiling, credential-free errors, a recording transport

spec.document: CrossRiver AI Platform on AgentCore, design specification 0.21 (2026-09-16)
spec.replacement_test: The generated clients from the contract registry replace the hand-written ones behind the same handler protocol; the recording transport becomes the registry's recorded contracts.
